reviews.title: Good so far
reviews.comment: I ran this card on popular shooter and rpg games for a total of over 300hrs with no issues. I confirmed it is not a counterfeit/ reflashed gpu. Fair price. Im satisfied with this purchase.

reviews.title: 5 Stars Sofar! (Will keep updated)
reviews.comment: I bought 2 of these overpriced Refurbished 2070 supers and so far they're working totally fine. They came in generic Uline boxes with respectable efforts towards protecting the contents. I am yet to test the second card but it arrived in equal condition and I expect it to work just as well. We'll see if they make the 90 day Amazon cut -.-
